mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.customer_id, c.customer_name, t.task_type, t.title, t.content, t.task_date, t.task_time, t.status, t.priority, t.owner_id, u.nickname AS owner_name, t.complete_time FROM crm_task t LEFT JOIN crm_customer c ON t.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.owner_id = u.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
